string.text: Communication with three points along a route has become unreliable. Visit them, inspect the approaches and update our map.
The route information is current again.
Our expendable medical stock is low. Assemble the requested batch and deliver it as one complete order.
The order is complete. Here is your payment.
A courier disappeared after the last checkpoint. Search the area and recover the package he was carrying.
Find and return the lost courier package.
The route ended badly, but the package arrived.
Two mutant packs share one position. Clear both groups in a single operation before they spread along the route.
Destroy both mutant groups around the nest.
The nest is empty and the route is open.
